WITH joined_data AS (
  SELECT 
    f.orderslink,
    u.acctscope,
    f.feerate
  FROM fees f
  INNER JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
  INNER JOIN users u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp
),
pair_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    orderslink,
    acctscope,
    AVG(feerate) as avg_feerate
  FROM joined_data
  WHERE feerate IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY orderslink, acctscope
),
overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_feerate) as mean_rate
  FROM pair_averages
),
filtered_pairs AS (
  SELECT 
    pa.orderslink,
    pa.acctscope,
    pa.avg_feerate,
    pa.avg_feerate - om.mean_rate as excess,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pa.acctscope ORDER BY (pa.avg_feerate - om.mean_rate) DESC) as rank_in_scope
  FROM pair_averages pa
  CROSS JOIN overall_mean om
  WHERE pa.avg_feerate > om.mean_rate
)
SELECT 
  orderslink,
  acctscope,
  avg_feerate,
  excess,
  rank_in_scope
FROM filtered_pairs
WHERE rank_in_scope <= 3
ORDER BY acctscope, rank_in_scope;
